Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

When Oliver's neighbor, Mr. Watson, decides to do some traveling, Oliver (Eddie Albert) buys the farm which adjoins his property, but not the house on it. Lisa (Eva Gabor) misunderstands and thinks the beautiful farmhouse is their new home.

Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers the only requirement to join the Hooterville Valley Fire Department is that he must play a musical instrument. Meanwhile Lisa (Eva Gabor) tries her hand at cooking something besides "hotscakes" for breakfast.

Believing he will never get a moment's peace, Oliver (Eddie Albert) is annoyed when Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts a listing in the new phone book: "Oliver Douglas, Attorney at Law"�but it is a different story when no one calls for his services.

Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s apple crop is ready to be harvested, and he decides to take them to market himself and make a killing. Of course, getting to market before the price drops proves a little more difficult than Oliver anticipates.

Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) becomes enamored of Mr. Kimball (Alvy Moore), the county agent. However, though she feminizes herself and gets all gussied up, he refuses to go out with a girl named Ralph. Can Oliver solve the situation legally?

Six months is up! Now, Lisa (Eva Gabor) gets to decide whether she and Oliver (Eddie Albert) will remain on the farm or go back to New York and their Park Avenue lifestyle! Will this be the final straw for Green Acres?

Sam Drucker (Frank Cady) is leaving on a much-needed two-week vacation and talks Oliver (Eddie Albert) into assuming his duties as deputy sheriff. But Oliver soon learns enforcing the law isn't quite as easy as it looks.

Whatever you do, don't say her name and especially while playing checkers down at Drucker's! An old hag named Molly Turgiss (Renie Riano), who died twenty years before the Douglases (Eddie Albert, Eva Gabor) came to town, might be haunting them.

It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get him�until the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.

Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Eb (Tom Lester) has a way with sick animals after Eb cures Arnold, the pig, and Alice, the chicken, and offers to put him through veterinary college. But will life in Green Acres ever be the same without Ed?!

A horse follows Oliver (Eddie Albert) home, but every time he tries to show it to his wife, the horse disappears. Lisa (Eva Gabor) assumes that her husband is imagining things�and as more animals show up, Oliver begins to think so too.

Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) takes Oliver (Eddie Albert) to Pixley Superior Municipal Court and sues him for non-payment of a vital contract over the little matter of some rain�or lack thereof. Does Mr. Haney know who he's up against? Does Oliver?

The Third-Tuesday-of-Every-Month-Culture-Committee of the Every-Other-Wednesday-Afternoon-Discussion-Club decides that Hooterville needs some "culture" in the form of a symphony orchestra. And Lisa (Eva Gabor) may just know the perfect conductor.

Oliver's (Eddie Albert) nephew Charles (Don Edmonds) arrives for a visit, and Oliver is completely shaken up when the boy turns out to be a long-haired, motorcycle-ridin', hippy-dippy type. But, boy, does he know a thing or two about engines.

Oliver dreams of entering his crop in the Corn Festival, but the dreaded "Bing Bug" invades Hooterville's farms. After learning of his service as a WWII pilot, the locals volunteer him for the perilous task of flying the town's only crop duster.

When a lovely, young and successful farmer comes to Oliver (Eddie Albert) for his legal counsel, Lisa (Eva Gabor) quickly becomes jealous of the two spending time together and becomes determined to break up what she sees as a budding romance.

When the Monroe Brothers show up to fix the Douglas's closet, Lisa learns that Ralph is devastated because her true love has stood her up on another date. Lisa's solution: an intensive, two-day beauty treatment for Ralph�and the barn for Oliver!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) takes to his soap box, delivering fiery, patriotic speeches after getting a bill from the State Farm Unattached Duty Tax for an outrageous $12.03! But no one can figure out why the tax is levied in the first place.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is curious to learn about the book that Oliver (Eddie Albert) is reading. It is the "real-life" story of pioneers Gus and Etta Thompson. The episode flashes back to the 19th century with Oliver appearing as Gus and Lisa as Etta.

Eb (Tom Lester) seeks dating advice from the Douglas's after laying eyes on former classmate Betty Jo Bradley from "petticoat Junction." Oliver's well-intentioned guidance has mixed results when Eb hilariously misconstrues the advice he's given.

The locals complain that Oliver's penchant for wearing business suits to do farm work is ruining Hooterville's image. Oliver tries to adjust, but the last laugh is on him when Lisa has her dressmaker design Italian him some swanky new overalls.

The Hooterville Chamber of Commerce attempts to attract a Hollywood film studio to shoot a movie in town. And when a rumor spreads that famous actor is arriving, the townsfolk are all abuzz as they prepare for their close-up, Mr. DeMille!

Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But wait�did he even want to?

Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville�and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc� stood him up at the alter on their big day.

Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

The Oilprince, a ruthless swindler, sells a bank worthless oil wells and schemes to divert settlers away from Shelly Lake for his own gain. His plans begin to unravel when Winnetou and his blood brother Old Surehand step in to protect the settlers and expose the fraud.
A young deputy tries to sober and revitalize a washed up, alcoholic sheriff to take down a pair of warring gangs of criminals in the Old West.
A self-proclaimed Russian prince, a Mexican bandit and a radical Irish female journalist team up during the Mexican Revolution to find fortune and notoriety.
Jeff Cameron is Tom Carter and he’s a man on a mission to get revenge for his brother Jerry, who was gunned down after pulling his life savings out of the Rio Canyon town bank.
Good Samaritan drifter, Benny Hudson and a stranded woman, Jenny finds themselves being torture; when they accidentally walk into an gang's hideout in a ghost town.

A gunslinger on the run for a murder he didn't commit goes to New Mexico where he hopes to find a person who can exculpate him. While on his way he finds a girl who has been kidnapped and tortured, sets her free and then takes his revenge at gunpoint.

programmes.t: Four Gunmen of the Holy Trinity
programmes.d: Arms trafficking with the Indians on the one hand and acquiring documents concerning the ownership of a goldmine on the other are the principal interests of Quin and Gomez, the highly suspicious guests at Papa Martinez' inn.

A young half-breed is saved from death and raised as a son by his rescuer. Years later, love and betrayal tear the family apart when he falls for his adoptive sister, while a vengeful woman plots the downfall of the man who once saved them both.

Johnny Ringo, a Texas Ranger, tracks down a counterfeiting ring, but the real challenge is a love triangle involving rancher Ray Scott, his sister Christine, saloon singer Annie, and gang boss Jackson. As Ringo tries to stop the counterfeiters, he learns the sheriff, his own partner, is behind it all, complicating the mission.

In revolutionary Mexico, General Ramirez hires the enigmatic gunfighter Hallelujah to intercept a fortune in jewels meant to fund Emperor Maximilian’s weapons. His mission spirals into chaos as he faces bandits, spies, impostors, and schemers in a wild chase through danger and deception.
Django returns home to discover that his father has been killed by local bandits in a business deal gone wrong.

In order to avenge a friend and to fulfill his last wish, Rocco has to find out what happened to an army corps that has mysteriously disappeared. He therefore puts on the disguise of a doctor and starts investigating in a somewhat uncomfortable town.
A Civil War veteran swears revenge when he returns home to find his family killed by a local gang.

programmes.t: Trusting Is Good... Shooting Is Better
programmes.d: Three bandits steal $200,000, but betrayal leaves the loot buried with a dying man. Glenn Hilton pursues the money, while the surviving thieves, a scheming banker, and the alluring Liz all try to claim a share. Greed, deceit, and double-crosses spark a chaotic hunt for the cash.

In Arkansas, a stagecoach robbery by Colonel Brinkley’s gang leaves one passenger dead and a treasure map split in two. His son Fred Engel joins Old Shatterhand and Winnetou to hunt the killers and recover the map. Their search leads them to a farm holding the second half—and to a race against Brinkley’s gang for the gold at Silver Lake.
Three cowboys, mistaken for members of an outlaw gang, are relentlessly pursued by a posse.

Framed for his brother’s murder by the Cris brothers, Gringo lands in prison with a friend. When the real killers escape and abduct Carmen, he must survive daring adventures to prove his innocence and rescue her.
After the Civil War, Michael "California" Random, is released from prison and goes to Missouri with his partner William.
Bank robbery pulled off by the bank officials, not the usual James gang.

programmes.t: Patience Has a Limit, We Don't
programmes.d: During the Civil War, Corporal MacDonald hides a large gold shipment meant for the Union. Before he can retrieve it, he's killed—taking the secret location with him. Now, a Union lieutenant and MacDonald's two sons compete to uncover the buried treasure in a tense hunt filled with danger and deception.
Spaghetti Western icon Anthony Steffen stars as Shenandoah, a mysterious man who joins a ruthless band of highwaymen after overcoming an almost impossible and death-defying initiation.

Stranger Lee Barton rides into Rainbow Valley, mistaken for a man thought dead. As tensions rise with ruthless town boss Tom Cherry—who's after hidden gold and the affections of a local woman—Barton is drawn into violence and revenge. With a sheriff's help, he seeks justice and a new start with a boy who believes he's his father.

programmes.t: There's a Noose Waiting for You Trinity!
programmes.d: Trinity is an ex-gunslinger desperately wanting to be forgiven and accepted by his family that he abandoned years earlier. Unfortunately for him, a ruthless bounty hunter is on his trail.

After witnessing his parents’ murder by a ruthless gang, a young man dedicates his life to becoming the fastest gun in the West. Years later, he returns to his hometown, armed with deadly skill and a thirst for vengeance, determined to face the killers who destroyed his family and reclaim his peace.

A shocking cheating rumor is exposed. Angela's new boo drops a bomb. Pepa and Tee Tee face off. Stevie J interrogates Savannah on how she's raking in serious cash. Uncle Luke's daughter Cree helps Jojo plan a surprise for Tanice.

Jojo and Tanice's anniversary party goes all the way left when Briana confronts Boogie about being a disloyal friend. Lil Twist and Cree clash. Vanessa presses Angela about meeting her new man. Savannah digs up dirt on Boogie before their first date.

Shocking rumors of infidelity run wild. Boogie's attempt at an intervention for Briana backfires, and the battle lines are drawn. Tee Tee presses Shawn to go to couple's counseling before their trip to the altar.

Angela breaks down in tears when her split with the boxer faces public scrutiny. Cree struggles to reconnect with her father Uncle Luke. Vanessa warns Tee Tee about the rumor spreading behind her back and all hell breaks loose.

Cree and her father Uncle Luke face off in a fiery reunion. The cheating rumor continues to wreak havoc upon Twist's party and Tee Tee's on the warpath. Savannah and Boogie's second uncovers their true feelings for one another.

Tee Tee and Shawn fire up the cheating rumor when their wedding plans derail. Treach checks Egypt and Sam about squashing the beef with Tee Tee and Jojo. Briana's party spirals into chaos when a fight breaks out between Savannah and Eric.

Stevie J puts Savannah in the hot seat for her spending. JoJo and Tanice decide to keep their pregnancy a secret. Tee Tee enlists the help of her mother Maureen to put a stop to the cheating rumor, and there's hell to pay.

After her breakup, Angela plans to bare it all in a sexy swimsuit calendar. Briana and Boogie's friendship comes to an ugly head. Jojo and Sam sit down to squash their beef, but Jojo's upcoming showcase is threatened when tempers flare.

A scandal involving Angela is exposed. The legends Pepa, Uncle Luke and Brat come together at the judge's panel for Jojo's showcase. Egypt's under pressure to perform solo for the first time without Sam. Treach steps in to heal the family.

Jojo's showcase ends in a melee between Tanice and Sakoya, Jojo Hailey's daughter who exposes Angela's past. For the first time in over a year, Egypt and Tee Tee come to a head and settle the score in an epic family reunion.

Treach lays down the law to Egypt when Sam's arrest spirals into danger. Twist breaks the news of a gun charge to Mack Maine. Angela's abrupt move to Atlanta leads to an explosive girl's night. JoJo and Tanice's struggles nearly shut cameras down.

All hell breaks loose at a party when a beef erupts, and fists fly. Twist faces gun charges in court. Cree visits Angela's new home in Atlanta and reveals a heartbreaking secret. Tee Tee and Shawn clash over wedding rings in their rush to the altar.

Pepa warns Sam to be cautious when he breaks the news that he may be facing some serious jail time. Tee Tee's wedding planning rushes on, but will Pepa and Egypt make the guestlist? Uncle Luke advises Cree on squashing the beef with Sakoya.

Stevie J. confronts Savannah about squashing the beef with Tiny's daughter Sakoya. Tyran struggles to reunite Pepa and Tee Tee before the wedding. YDB steps onto the scene when JoJo gets the guys get together for some off-road action.

A surprise bachelor and bachelorette party for Tee Tee and Shawn ends in disaster. Treach supports Egypt's music career while Sam faces serious prison time. Eric and Layzie visit Eazy-E's gravesite, but rumors around his death must be put to rest.

JoJo and Tanice find themselves in a marriage crisis when JoJo's stood up on a group date. Tee Tee and Shawn's wedding plans spiral out of control. Sam seeks guidance from Layzie. Danger strikes for Briana when police come knocking at her door.

Briana's arrest spirals into a traumatic breakdown. Egypt's family crisis leads her to reach out to Tee Tee. Twist is under Young Money pressure when he returns to the stage for a big performance. JoJo and Tanice's marriage struggle gets real.

Between Covid, financial issues, a rainstorm and Pep not being invited, Tee Tee and Shawn's wedding falls apart. JoJo and Tanice are rocked by challenges of married life. Eric confronts Layzie Bone about his involvement in the Eazy-E Documentary.

Tee Tee's wedding day spirals into chaos, but a surprise from Pep shocks all. Meanwhile, Treach warns Sam that a dangerous future lies ahead and enforces protection over Egypt. Jojo plans something special for Tanice to keep the marriage lit.

Tee Tee and Maureen confront Pep about Egypt. Briana's new fling shocks all and brings her face to face with Pep at a family party. JoJo fights to save his marriage with a big surprise for Tanice. Eric spills the tea on his past with Tee Tee.
Angela plans for baby number two and visits a fertility doctor. Tee Tee and Egypt's rivalry comes to an unexpected head. Egypt rushes to marry her fiancé Sam even though Sam faces serious jail time.

Egypt and Sam rush to the little white chapel, but when they drop the bomb on Pep and Treach, Pep objects! Tanice and Sakoya's feud comes to a head. Eazy-E's celebration pushes the group to come together in peace and settle their differences.

The 50th anniversary of Hip Hop brings Bone Thugs-n-Harmony, Treach, and Kurupt onto one stage. A new baby is coming, but not everyone thinks it's good news. Meanwhile, a long-held secret romance is exposed, and an old rival makes a dramatic return.

Cree confronts Briana over fiery sneak disses on social media; Sakoya suspects her Mom is not being honest and discovers a troubling secret. Tyran offers Sam support as he deals with the aftermath of meeting Treach. Twist finds himself a new crush.

A pregnant Egypt goes on tour with Pepa, while Sam stays home alone. Jojo returns to music, and asks Eric to collaborate on a song. Aaliyah and Eric clash over Eric's gambling habit. Tiny and Sakoya have an explosive argument over Tiny's love life.

TT and Shawn clash over their new life in LA, Vanessa gets liposuction, and Cree and Briana finally faceoff over Briana's fiery sneak disses. Meanwhile, Twist plays peacemaker, and Layzie surprises Sakoya by showing up to her skate party uninvited.

Sam switches careers from rapper to food truck owner. Cree and Briana have an explosive confrontation at Briana's party. JoJo makes an offer on a house in Los Angeles, but keeps it a secret from Tanice.

Tee Tee decides to bury the hatchet when she learns that Egypt is pregnant. Twist turns to God to resist temptation, and tries to find his way back to an old flame. Aaliyah has had enough with Eric's gambling, and decides to do something about it.

Jojo confronts Buck over his toxic behavior; Sakoya attempts to mend her relationship with Tiny. Egypt and Sam decide who will be invited to their wedding. Treach suspects Sam has ulterior motives for marrying Egypt. Layzie mourns his Mother.

Romeo says he's changed & wants to apologize, but will his apology be accepted? Sam's case goes to court, and he gets news he didn't want to hear. Eric and Aaliyah finally discuss their issues, and Tanice and her dad clash over throwing ice at Jojo.

Romeo wants to apologize to Angela and Jojo, but they're hesitant to meet with him. Egypt continues to plan her wedding amid Sam's court case and unanswered RSVPs. Angela performs for the first time, but will her nerves get the best of her?

Romeo & Angela talk for the first time in years, but can their relationship be healed? Sam & Egypt celebrate their second wedding ceremony. To celebrate 50 years of Hip Hop, legends grace the stage, along with the cast, in an epic performance.

Bow Wow's arrest blows up in the tabloids and causes an uproar with Da Brat. R. Kelly's arrest ignites a buzzing child support battle with ex-wife Drea Kelly. Waka Flocka and wife Tammy Rivera put their wedding renewal vows to the ultimate test.

Bow faces tough love about his arrest and a dark cloud threatens to send him back to jail. Tammy's heart-to-heart with Drea Kelly sparks a revelation about her marriage to Waka. Deb's godson Brandon returns but bad blood isn't reconciled so easily.

A surprise visit from Angela Simmons rocks Bow's world! Tammy's insecurities threaten her first sexy music video. Ayana and Brandon face off and Waka questions Brandon's motives. Eazy-E's daughter seeks guidance from Deb and Brat.

Breaking news regarding R. Kelly's child support battle explodes into chaos. Deb and Brat clash over Drea Kelly. Ayana raises suspicions about Brandon firefighting; Bow and Brandon face off. ReeMarkable's performance backfires.

JD's throws a star-studded skate party including Usher and T-Boz. Snoop dishes out tough love on Bow. Brat blows up on LisaRaye when bankruptcy pushes her to a breaking point. Waka warns Deb that Brandon needs to steer clear of the family or else.

Bow enters dangerous territory when he meets a fiery new woman. ReeMarkable blows off her boyfriend and suffers the pay back. Deb has a family dinner to confront Brandon about a big fat lie. Waka reaches his boiling point and goes in for the kill.

Brandon's lies are exposed and that brings Brandon and Waka nearly to blows. Warning signs arise when Corri marks her territory with Bow. Brat questions ReeMarkable's intentions. Bow disses Drea Kelly right to her face.
Tammy goes ballistic when she catches Waka in a lie. Bow is blindsided when he learns of Corri's dangerous past. ReeMarkable disrespects Deb and Da Brat and battle lines are drawn.

After putting Corri on ice, Bow makes a bold move and invites his ex, Angela Simmons to Shaniah's 21st birthday bash. Corri keeps tabs on Bow's moves. Tension between Da Brat and Drea Kelly escalates. Waka enters the lion's den with Tammy.

Brandon returns and makes a shocking confession. Deb and Brat explode after giving ReeMarkable one last chance. All hell breaks loose when Corri shows up on a rampage against Bow. Tammy's big NYC show goes off the rails.

As Atlanta emerges from quarantine, the cast struggles to navigate a new world in troubling times. Bow's scandalous album rocks Atlanta, Ayana receives a terrifying health diagnosis, and Deb drops a bomb that shocks Waka and threatens her reputation.

Despite warnings, Bow threatens to tell all about his exes on his new album. When an ex shows up in ATL, Bow is forced to face the past. Deb's secret creates turmoil that could tank her reputation. The stress of it sends someone over the edge.

Tammy and Deb clash over politics; Waka gets caught in the crossfire. Pimpin' has to face the music when his ex Diamond confronts him. Sexual tension fuels their fiery fight suggesting they may not be over after all. Jhonni has to fess up to Deb.

Brat presses Judy to move to ATL. Hurricane's desperate to help a sick Ayana, but Shaniah takes a different approach. Ree's ready to reconcile with Brat and Deb, but will they give her another chance? Diamond's album release party ends in turmoil.

A fight at Diamond's party steals her spotlight, creating a conflict that threatens to tear the cast apart when Deb unites everyone on a new project. Brat is angry when she hears that Deb is keeping things from her. Ayana recovers from COVID-19.

Nikushin consigue permiso para que Rita y Lavrov visiten a Kosarev en prisión. Durante una fiesta en honor al dueño de la clínica psiquiátrica, Lavrov confronta al desconocido que irrumpió en su oficina. Más tarde, él y Rita dejan la ciudad para entrevistarse con Kosarev. Mientras tanto, un desconocido irrumpe en el apartamento donde se esconde Katya.

A través del análisis psicológico, Lavrov descubre que Kosarev conoce al verdadero asesino, pero se niega a revelar su identidad. Nikushin encuentra a Katya en un hotel. Un compañero de celda de Kosarev le entrega a Rita y Lavrov una carta que Kosarev intentó destruir. Aunque el remitente usa una dirección falsa, la información hace que Lavrov sospeche de Nikushin.

Lavrov intenta advertir a Katya del peligro, pero ella no le cree. Rita, por su parte, duda de la culpabilidad de Nikushin. Mientras Lavrov investiga el pasado de Nikushin, Rita sigue una pista sobre la posible implicación de medicamentos en los asesinatos en serie. Katya le confiesa a Nikushin que en el pasado ya intentaron asesinarla. Esa misma noche, otra mujer es asesinada.

Lavrov descubre que estaba equivocado sobre Starostin. Nikushin esconde a Katya en un apartamento secreto y entre ellos surge una atracción. Lavrov empieza a sentirse vigilado, instala una cámara oculta en su oficina y, al revisar las grabaciones, reconoce a alguien entrando. Esa noche, aparece inesperadamente en la casa de Rita, causando un gran susto a su madre.

Claudia está desesperada por comenzar a minar, pero las brutales condiciones del camino la hacen preguntarse si la tripulación logrará llegar a su reclamo.
Mientras Guy y Gary se apresuran a arreglar el camino destrozado hacia el reclamo, Claudia espera que un nuevo miembro de la tripulación sea el billete de la suerte.
La juerga de compras sorpresa de Robin estresa a Claudia cuando sus errores de compra retrasan la temporada minera.
Claudia intenta mantener la paz cuando Robin y su padre chocan, mientras el equipo lucha por solucionar un problema tras otro en su camión minero.
Gary y Josh están frustrados por una serie de crisis, mientras Claudia hace un anuncio impactante que descarrila los planes de Robin y provoca un conflicto entre la pareja.
Tensions boil over between Robin, Josh and Steve about how to mine and when Claudia steps in, things get downright explosive.
Plagados de problemas con los camiones, Robin y su equipo corren para hacer un suministro de combustible antes de que el equipo se agote.
Robin choca con Claudia y Josh por la calidad del jade que sale de su pozo, mientras que el intento de Larry de ayudar a llevar el barracón de la tripulación al campamento fracasa.
Claudia y su equipo están decididos a seguir minando a pesar de los incendios forestales que arden alrededor de su reclamo, hasta que las cosas empeoran y tienen que correr para salir.
Después de perder dos semanas de minería en los incendios forestales, Claudia y Robin corren el riesgo de regresar a Two Mile y apostar por la apertura de un nuevo pozo.
Claudia se estresa tratando de preparar su mejor jade para los compradores, mientras la moral de su equipo se pone a prueba mientras luchan contra el frío.
Claudia hace todo lo posible para intentar hacer una gran venta a los compradores de jade, mientras en la mina Guy y Gary luchan contra la primera tormenta de nieve de la temporada.
Claudia presiona a su equipo para que siga minando a pesar de las gélidas temperaturas y el deterioro de las condiciones de las carreteras.
La temporada de Claudia comienza con fuerza cuando recibe un pedido de jade por valor de 250 000 dólares.
Después de años de obtener la parte dura del trato con Scrappy Larry, Robin le hace una broma a su viejo amigo.
Bajo presión para cumplir con el ajustado plazo de su comprador, Robin y Josh chocan cuando se topan con interminables problemas.
Cuando una avería grave amenaza con cerrar la mina, Claudia y Robin toman la arriesgada decisión.
Josh evita por poco el desastre al entrar a la mina con una carga de combustible y Claudia queda devastada.
Claudia y Robin se apresuran a encontrar una segunda roca de jade antes de que su comprador abandone el trato.

Honeymooners Nick and Lori head off to the Grand Canyon for adventure and time alone together.
A filmmaker follows Tim Heidecker during the final month of his campaign for district attorney. Tim’s motivations and controversial past begin to unravel his candidacy.

A coming-of-age story about four working-class friends growing up in Long Island, New York, as clam diggers.
Simon is a timid man living an isolated existence. New co-worker James is both Simon’s exact physical double and his opposite. The confident and charismatic James slowly starts taking over his life.
On the eve that the crew of the very first manned expedition to Mars is about to return to Earth, it makes an astounding discovery - fossilized evidence of life on Mars.
Centurion is set during the war between Roman soldiers and Pict tribesmen during the 2nd century Roman conquest of Britain.
Jack and Diane, two teenage girls, meet on a summer day in New York City and spend the night kissing ferociously.
An American teenager sent to stay with relatives in the English countryside finds her idyllic summer days shattered as a conflict in Europe escalates, and the UK falls into a chaotic military state.
In the year 2707, war rages between Earth’s four giant corporations as they battle over the planet’s dwindling resources.
A grief-stricken young widow flees the city to cope with the loss of her husband. When she's kidnapped by a man and locked in a cabin, she escapes into the wilderness and is pursued by her captor.
It's 1999 and a drug-addicted nurse, her scheming cousin and a group of black market organ-trading criminals get caught up in a heist gone wrong. Starring Angela Bettis (“Dexter,” Carrie).
The year is 1348. Europe has fallen under the shadow of the Black Death. As the plague decimates all in its path, fear and superstition are rife.
When 13-year-old Jake's grandfather dies, his family moves from Manhattan back into his father's Brooklyn home.
A hastily married couple quickly devolve into a life of affairs, meddling parents, and therapy.
It's been a decade since Ben (Duplass) and Andrew (Leonard) were the bad boys of their college campus. Ben has settled down and found a job, wife, and home.
Frank (Joel Murray) has had enough of the downward spiral of American culture. Divorced, recently fired, and possibly terminally ill, Frank feels he has nothing left to live for.

Meg is faced with the decision to stay in the place she loves or to leave with the man she loves.

Claire's relationships are fragmented.
Claire is taking the loss of Peter and Tess badly.

Harry lends Claire his prize bull, which upsets Tess for not being consulted.

With last-minute wedding preparations underway, Jodi's father blows in unexpectedly.
Becky senses mystery about Jake's past when he convinces her to help him save a prized racehorse from thieves.

Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.
Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.
This lavish musical is the story of a poor man whose love and faith help him face oppression.
Barbra Streisand directs and stars as a young woman who poses as a boy to attend a Jewish religious school.
When a Valley Girl finds love with a rocker, her girlfriends find him "grody to the max!"
Funnymen Danny DeVito and Billy Crystal are a momma's boy and a writer who "agree" to swap murders!
The unlikely duo of a retired hockey player and an elitist figure skater go for Olympic gold together.
The true story of the infamous 1919 Chicago White Sox scandal, when the team throws the World Series.
Baseball season gets off to a rocky start when a veteran catcher and cocky young pitcher compete over a woman.
Diane Keaton shines as a driven career woman who finds her life turned upside down when she “inherits” a baby.
Jack and Caroline are a happy couple... until a layoff makes him a house husband and her a working wife!
A young woman wants the wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob a bank.

Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!
Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.
When Alex Murphy is critically injured, OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.
An uptight cop tries to protect the widow of a drug boss as they are pursued across Texas!
To save her family from a farmer's plow, a mild-mannered mouse has a plan to move her house!
A host of stars voice this delightful animated tale of a dog sent back to Earth from Heaven.
Those lovable mutts Charlie and Itchy return for an all new animated, musical adventure!
To prove himself, Igor, a mad scientist's assistant, creates a sweet, show-tune-singing monster.

Greetings, Earthlings. A pint-sized extraterrestrial has just landed on Earth by accident...and he's feeling a little, well, alienated because he got separated from his family. But MAC will transform the lives of everyone he meets...forever!
In this classic comedy, a teenager's life is improved when his werewolf nature bursts through!
A bump on the head has bored housewife (Rosanna Arquette) believing she is the mysterious Susan (Madonna).
A classic comedy about finding your heart...and kidnapping a date for your school reunion!

When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?
Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.
Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.
In New York of the 1920s, three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

Anthony Hopkins delivers a brilliant portrayal as William Bligh, the sea captain who, in 1787, steered The Bounty on a 27,000-mile voyage into danger, chaos and madness, and whose first mate (Mel Gibson) lead a legendary mutiny against him..

Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.
A disabled teen enters a magical realm where warrior-kangaroos battle evil, finding his true strength in this action-packed fantasy.
Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

When it comes to laying down the law, one man can make a difference! Action superstar Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson takes no prisoners as he fights for justice and crushes corruption in this story of one man who takes a stand and takes back his town!
In this action-packed sequel, Kevin Sorbo discovers the quiet town he grew up in is now overrun by a violent gang. And it's up to him to take it back!
Ex-CIA agent (Burt Reynolds) has his quiet life disrupted when he stumbles onto a military conspiracy led by a rightwing zealot (Cliff Robertson).

Burt Reynolds stars as a moonshiner who wages war against corrupt police officials in this action extravaganza full of epic car chases, bone-crunching brawls and terrific acting by a stellar cast that includes Ned Beatty, Diane Ladd and Bo Hopkins.

The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

When a vicious motorcycle gang launches an assault on a small town and a local girl (Elizabeth James), Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) goes on a one-man crusade to save the town and the girl! The first of the wildly successful Billy Jack feature films.

Enraged when a biker gang kills his fiancée (Cheryl Ladd), a Green Beret (Tony Young) declares war and discovers that revenge is a dish best served...with a rocket launcher! Also stars William Smith, Marvin Gaye, Peter Brown and Michael Sterns.

When the leader of the Glory Stompers is brutally attacked by a psychotic rival biker gang that kidnaps his girl and leaves him for dead, he gathers a few buddies and sets out to settle the score! Starring Dennis Hopper, Jody McCrea and Casey Kasem.
When a biker gang cyclist is injured and hospitalized, he is kidnapped from the hospital but dies. A funeral is staged in the local church with a drunken, drugged-out orgy.

The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.
Every 22 years, a jinxed vampire is fated to lose his beloved at the hands of a crazy pirate. But with his new band, he’s going to end the curse!
Dracula finds a victim with the perfect blood to resurrect his bloodsucking bride, but an error results in an unexpected change to his beloved.
Dracula flees Europe and ends up in a small California town. And his ravenous thirst is quickly turning the Golden State into…the ghoulish state!
When a physician accidentally swallows experimental bat serum pills, he finds himself saving patients by day…and sucking their blood by night!
In Paris, a theatrical company with a specialty in Grand Guignol undertakes their most gruesome production yet! And the blood will flow!
Shelley Winters puts the Grande in Grande Dame Guignol in director Curtis Harrington's atmospheric, suspenseful and surprisingly moving cult chiller.
In this cult-classic thriller, Kay Lenz and Shelley Winters star as a co-ed and the witchy head of a sorority who has special plans for the new girl.
In this terrifying sequel, the spirits of the dead are still hell-bent on luring the Freeling's daughter to the other side, where lies only evil!
Nancy Allen, Tom Skerritt, Zelda Rubenstein and Heather O'Rourke star in this suspense-filled conclusion to the terrifying "Poltergeist" trilogy.

James Brolin, Margot Kidder and Rod Steiger star in this horror classic as George and Kathy Lutz (Brolin, Kidder) buy their dream home only for it to becomes a hellish nightmare as satanic forces haunt them with sheer, unbridled evil!

The home of unspeakable evil is back! Tony Roberts, Tess Harper, Robert Joy, Candy Clark and Meg Ryan star in this third outing to Amityville in which a skeptical journalist sets out to debunk the Amityville house's reputation for unspeakable evil.
Karen Black, Oliver Reed and Bette Davis star in this chiller as a family is surrounded by an evil  presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder.
When a horror novelist tries to "kill off" his successful author pseudonym, he finds his alter ego on a greusome quest for revenge.

programmes.t: Stephen King's Sometimes They Come Back
programmes.d: A high school teacher (Tim Matheson) faces the demon ghosts of a gang of former students. Based on a short story by Stephen King.
Basil Rathbone, Bela Lugosi, Lon Chaney, Jr. and John Carradine star in this terrifying horror classic about a brain surgeon's unorthodox experiments.

programmes.t: The Monster That Challenged The World
programmes.d: The beaches go from fun-filled swim-fests to horrifying slug-fests when gargantuan vampire snails threaten to suck the life out of all mankind!
An American reporter in Japan becomes the unwitting subject of a mad scientist’s twisted experiment in this terrifying tale of ambition gone berserk.

programmes.t: X: The Man With The X-Ray Eyes
programmes.d: In this cult-classic, a driven scientist discovers that his x-ray vision formula brings with it incredible powers…and incredible temptations.

Norman Taylor has been enjoying unusual success at work lately, but could it be due to the magic his wife practices in secret? Infuriated upon discovering her methods, he destroys her protective spells, putting both their lives in mortal danger.
One of the great horror anthology films, and director Mario Bava's personal favorite of his works, "Black Sabbath" tells three short tales of horror.
Christopher Lee plays the Lord Chief Justice of 17th century England who condemns women as witches to further his political and sexual needs.
In 18th century Europe, a vampire with lesbian tendencies ravages the young girls and townsfolk who, years earlier, killed off her fellow vampires.
Horror, suspense, and the occult mix to make this a hair-raising experience even for veteran horror fans.
In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother…who is blind.
Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.

In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.
Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory – and a cunning woman – to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!

Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

Sharpshooter Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) thinks he's been hired to kill wild dogs in Australia. But a wealthy cattle baron (Alan Rickman) has far more nefarious plans for the sharpshooter. Laura San Giacomo also stars in this stylish western.

Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

Jeff Bridges stars as Wild Bill Hickok, the hard-drinking, quick-shooting gunslinger who lived on the edge. Hickok's amazing story is told with a stunning visual style, illuminating one of the most exciting heroes of the American West.

Mario Van Peebles and Billy Zane shake up the frontier in this gun-blazing, fist-pounding western that takes a page missing from the history books and unfolds it with suspense, humor and awe-inspiring power! Pam Grier and Isaac Hayes co-star.

Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.
Audie Murphy plays a troubled saddle tramp with a penchant for drinking. After inheriting a ranch, he is led back into the arms of an old flame.

When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

When an outlaw is shot during a heist and left for dead by his partners - who take his money and his woman - he sets out to track them down. And when he catches up with them, he'll have to rely on his wits...as much as the loaded gun in his holster!

As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!
Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun.

Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

Jesse James and his gang ride again! David , Keith and Robert Carradine; James and Stacy Keach; Randy and Dennis Quaid; Christopher and Nicholas Guest depict real-life siblings in this charged portrayal of the Old West's legendary bandits.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. James Greenblatt, a pioneer in the field of integrative medicine who has been treating patients with eating disorders for many decades. His nutritional approach to psychiatry is revolutionary and has helped patients worldwide. He is the author of seven books, including Answers to Anorexia and Finally Focused: The Breakthrough Natural Treatment Plan for ADHD.

Founder, Glenn Marsden, of Imperfectly Perfect Campaign, and Jeremy Jackson, former Baywatch star share their personal journeys with body dysmorphia and how it led to a worldwide campaign. A young man faces his fears and a tale of kindness at 30,000 ft.

Laura Di Franco, CEO of Brave Healer Productions, discusses brave healing and the power of sharing our stories. And, meet Oyen the ginger cat and adorable kids from India, along with Daaji redefining meditation for a joyful heart.

Join The Kitchen Psychic, Hannah McKitrick, as we talk ditching diets, embracing food freedom, and finding lightness in mind and body, alongside Susan Noles from The Golden Bachelor for some fun, and meditation leader Daaji discussing compassion.

Raelene S. Weaver, author and TEDx speaker who's breaking barriers by normalizing boys' emotions. Witness a touching moment as a man in Italy feels a human touch after 30 years, and Daaji joins for another inspiring segment on our Soul Hugs series.

In our very first solo episode of Rooted in Wellness, we explore the transformative power of being anchored like a sturdy tree—steady, grounded, and unwavering amidst life's storms. We'll illuminate how feeling rooted manifests as inner peace, emotional stability, and a profound connection with yourself and the world around you.

Have you ever felt like your hormones are playing a tune out of sync with your well-being? Chances are, they probably are. The good news? There's a transformative journey waiting for women when they realign with nature, pay attention to their meals, and practice intermittent fasting the right way.

Did you know that your metabolic health and energy are controlled by our modern food? This means your metabolism is not broken! You just need to work on healing your metabolism through simple lifestyle shifts you can easily apply to your life today.How? This is what we dive into in this episode of Rooted in Wellness with Casey Means.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

The team, led by Anand, prepare for their motorcycle adventure to the four sacred peaks. The first practice ride is here in the birthplace of yoga, but it is not encouraging as monsoons are destroying roads and villages, Fred seems a liability and Ryan's seizures could be an issue.

Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

A teenager's investigation into his father's death leads him to a hidden city populated with menacing warriors.
An Irish hustler (Robert Arkins) puts together a Dublin band that covers hits of 1960s American soul.

An insurance executive (Linda Fiorentino) skips town with drug money and stops at nothing to get what she wants.

A teen (John Patrick White) learns his nerdy math-teacher father (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) is an ex-CIA operative hunted by assassins.
Friendship helps make nightmarish office jobs bearable for four young women working as temporary employees.
Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.
Dos bebés intercambiados al nacer son criados por familias diferentes, lo que lleva a una disputa legal.
Los adolescentes luchan contra trastornos de salud mental que les hacen terminar prematuramente con sus vidas.

Se sigue el rastro de denuncias ciudadanas sobre maltrato animal, feminicidios, negligencia en geriátricos y cirugías estéticas. Casos de justicia demorada y respuestas ciudadanas que exigen sanciones y reformas, luchando por la verdad y la justicia.

María Teresa y José Andrés, ex empleados de casinos, enfrentan millonarios embargos por sanciones de Coljuegos, pese a no ser los dueños. Coljuegos no investigó a los verdaderos responsables. Las víctimas buscan justicia y esperan que Coljuegos rectifique sus errores.

El 8 de marzo de 2010, dos niños fueron hallados muertos en Bogotá. Su madre, Ana Milena Yate, y su pareja, John Edison Zapata, fueron condenados a 60 años por el homicidio. Ambos participaron en el crimen tras una noche de alcohol y violencia.

En 2011, en Anzoátegui, Tolima, los gemelos Diego y Juan Sebastián, de 7 años, fueron secuestrados por Pedro Andrés Laserna, expareja de su madre Mariela, tras ella terminar la relación y denunciarlo por violencia. Laserna exigió dinero y su regreso a cambio de los niños, pero finalmente los asesinó. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por secuestro extorsivo agravado y homicidio agravado.

Martha Luz creía ciegamente en Jhon Fredy, su pareja, un yerbatero con antecedentes de abuso sexual. Cuando sus hijos Lizbey y Juan Pablo desaparecen en 2010, la policía sospecha del padrastro por su actitud extraña. Los cuerpos aparecen brutalmente asesinados en un río. Jhon confiesa el doble crimen alegando motivos esotéricos, mientras Martha, señalada como cómplice, es condenada como coautora del homicidio de sus propios hijos.
En Tame, Arauca, un militar fue condenado a 60 años por violar y asesinar brutalmente a tres niños. El Tribunal Superior de Bogotá lo encontró culpable de acceso carnal violento y homicidio agravado.

El 17 octubre del 2015, en el corregimiento de Belén, en El Banco Magdalena, dos hombres abusaron y asesinaron a Valeria Peña, una menor de 15 años que logró sobrevivir antes los ataques y dejar un testimonio donde señalaba a José Fernando López como el autor material de su crimen. Sin embargo, un tercer testimonio involucro al hermano de José Fernando y el autor intelectual quien tenía claras intenciones de venganza.

Frank Faruk Rodríguez, se entregó a las autoridades y confeso que asesino a su cuñada y Sofía, su sobrina de seis años. Después de haber confesado el crimen ahora niega los hechos. Finalmente, en junio 13 de 2012, Fran Faruk fue condenado a la pena de 56 años y 3 meses de prisión. Próximamente, se le abrirá un nuevo proceso penal por la conducta sexual contra su sobrina Angie Sofía Guzmán.
María Elena, vendedora ambulante, es asesinada por su novio Damián tras negarse a abortar su hijo. Su cuerpo es encontrado sin útero.

Ariana García, de 19 años, está demandando a sus padres por angustia emocional y abuso, alegando que la negativa de sus padres a reconocer y respetar su privacidad y sus límites emocionales la ha llevado a perder amigos, confianza y negocios lucrativos como influencer de viajes.

Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.

Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

El padre franciscano Gabriel Gutiérrez, conocido como "Fray ñero", murió por COVID-19 el 2 de abril. Dedicó su vida a ayudar a habitantes de calle en Bogotá, especialmente tras el desalojo de El Bronx en 2016. Fundó Callejeros de la Misericordia, organización que acompaña a poblaciones vulnerables como vendedores informales, recicladores y trabajadoras sexuales. Su legado de compasión permanece en el centro de la ciudad.

Tres historias: Pirry, reconocido periodista, revela su lucha contra la depresión tras años documentando crímenes como el de Garavito. En Nueva Venecia, niños juegan fútbol sobre una cancha flotante en la Ciénaga Grande, soñando con ser estrellas pese a la pobreza. Y Zach Morris, un youtuber estadounidense, cuenta cómo Colombia se convirtió en su hogar tras años luchando por su nacionalidad.

Édgar Jiménez, "El Chino", fue el fotógrafo de confianza de Pablo Escobar durante casi dos décadas, con acceso íntimo a su vida en la Hacienda Nápoles. Amigo de infancia del capo, documentó desde animales exóticos hasta su campaña política, sobreviviendo a la masacre de "Los Pepes" contra allegados de Escobar. Hoy vive humildemente en Medellín, dejando un archivo gráfico único sobre el narcotráfico colombiano.
Autumn descubre que Antoine la engañó con su amiga y teme más secretos. Ricky admite a Chelsea haber estado con su madrastra Tecki, ¿dice la verdad?
